scope: Deterministic tests of shipped solo rules through original command handlers. Browser rendering and user input are tested separately. Opus inventory gating is client-side and is not proven by this rule-only test.
checks: Distant interactions do not award a ring
One player can collect all three rings
One player completes fruit, campfire, three animals, three-stage cabin and celebration through original command handlers
Completed world persists in the solo save
Opus handlers deny duplicate collection, create animal produce and complete five cabin stages
